title: How Anthropic’s Dynamic Workflows Coordinate Claude Agents (Updated with video!)
author: Richard MacManus
description: At AI Engineer New York, Anthropic drew on lessons from Unix and Linux to explain how agents can tackle bigger projects without overwhelming developers.
summary: CJ Avilla and Harrison Stall, Members of Technical Staff at Anthropic, at AI Engineer NYC today. The AI Engineer New York 2026 conference kicked off this morning with a series of workshops, including Anthropic discussing how to orchestrate its Claude Managed Agents .
takeaways: “And we’re sitting there in our GitHub trying to approve PRs and make sure that everything works as expected.” From agent rosters to dynamic workflows The pair noted that dynamic workflows began in Claude Code as the “a harness for every task” concept.
The AI Engineer New York 2026 conference kicked off this morning with a series of workshops, including Anthropic discussing how to orchestrate its Claude Managed Agents .
The lesson: agents need the same level of organization in order to do the types of big, ambitious projects Anthropic envisions for dynamic workflows.
